EffectSummary: Create illusionary cover; allies behind count as in cover for targeting/LOS.
After healing an ally, grant small DR vs next attack or reduced damage on first hit.
Place a duplicate of an ally; first attack that would hit them instead hits the illusion and misses.
Healed allies gain brief blur effect: reduced damage from ranged or distant attacks.
Create zone granting DR to allies; enemies see illusory copies and may mis-target or deal reduced damage.
Healing or cleansing also places an illusion that grants allies small Speed/positioning bonuses.
Briefly cloak party in illusions; incoming attacks that turn are partially redirected or reduced.
Heals also grant short-lived illusion shields (extra effective HP for 1–2 turns).
Large AOE illusion that strongly protects allies and causes enemies to waste actions or move toward false positions.
While Alithia is alive, each ally gains a small defensive illusion effect vs first attack per encounter.
